do.text: Say what happened in a few words: the toast leaves on its own.

dont.text: Don't put a paragraph in a toast: no one can read it before it goes.

do.text: Offer Undo on a toast for an action that can be undone.

dont.text: Don't make a toast the only way to recover from a destructive action: confirm it first with an [Alert dialog](/components/alert-dialog).
